text:
zoe: Quick announce — Hosted API 'edge-lite' endpoint + mosaic-edge model are GA. Rolling docs and SDK updates now. :tada:
pat: Congrats! Any breaking changes for clients?
zoe: No billing changes. Default now uses websocket multiplexing for connections to save battery/slots. Legacy single-conn will be supported for 45 days, deprecation warnings start in 7 days.
eng-bot: Perf snapshot (64 tokens): p50=33ms, p90=110ms, p99=270ms on mosaic-edge w/ 8-bit quant on mobile profile.
mike: SRE note — enable rate-limited connection backoff at 25% rollout. Watch for connection churn and 502 spikes.
ops-team: Rollout plan: 10% -> 40% (12h) -> 100% (36h). Partners will get an email with migration steps and a migration snippet.
pat: Can you paste the JS migration example?
zoe: Sure:
```
import {EdgeClient} from '@redwood/edge-sdk';
const client = new EdgeClient({ url: 'wss://hosted.redwood.ai/edge/v1' });
await client.open({ model: 'mosaic-edge-v1', multiplex: true });
client.stream({ prompt: 'Summarize this' })
  .on('delta', d => console.log(d))
  .on('end', () => console.log('done'));
```
mike: Ops will monitor websocket error rate; pager if >1.5% for 5m.
zoe: Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/edge-ga — reach out if you want a walkthrough. :shipit:
